prompt: Save this source and its claim. I think the same canonical documentation URL may already be in research/memory/sources/.

assertions.name: searches_existing_sources
assertions.description: Response shows evidence of searching existing source records before creating new ones

assertions.name: reuses_existing_source_id
assertions.description: When the same canonical URL/resource exists, reuses the existing source ID rather than creating a duplicate

assertions.name: reconciles_claims
assertions.description: Reconciles the new claim with semantically/lexically relevant existing claims

assertions.name: avoids_duplicate_canonical_records
assertions.description: Does not create multiple source records for the same canonical resource

assertions.name: preserves_source_metadata
assertions.description: Maintains source identity, type, location, and other metadata correctly
